summary: Adds password vault export and CSV import to plugins/plugin-native-passwords as a separate native Capacitor plugin (ElizaPasswordTransfer). Export requires a fresh BiometricPrompt/device-credential authentication and an explicit confirmation, then writes CSV only to a user-picked Storage Access Framework document. Import parses a user-picked CSV natively, binds every row to exactly one HTTPS origin, shows those origins for review, and only adds entries (never overwrites). Results are counts only.

contract.exportVault: () -> {exported:number}. Locks the vault, prompts a fresh device authentication, counts bindings, confirms ('NOT encrypted'), ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT text/csv, then writes name,url,username,password,note with one row per binding (app bindings as android://<sha256>@<package>). Rejections use fixed messages/codes: cancelled, empty, locked, key-invalidated, unavailable, write-failed.
contract.importVault: () -> {imported:number, skipped:number}. Requires an unlocked vault; ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT; at most 2 MB, 1000 rows, UTF-8; columns found by header (Chrome, Firefox, Bitwarden, Proton layouts); origin = https scheme + host + non-default port (path/query/fragment dropped); http, android:// and invalid addresses, empty passwords, over-long values, in-file duplicates and existing origin+username pairs are skipped with fixed reasons; a native review lists the exact origins; entries are added with saveEntry(null, ...) only after confirmation; parsed secrets are held in char[] and wiped.
contract.secrets: No method resolves with a password, username, label, address or file content; no logging; Intents carry only the document title.

applicationModel: Adds five files to the pinned password manager. Reference only: it is not materialized or registered in Alpha. Native document-picker, lifecycle and grant-ticket qualification are still required.

reviewFindings: Queued reads and writes must retain the exact grant that admitted the transfer.
Picker and review-dialog lifecycle must cancel or settle abandoned work without publishing stale results.
Import must recheck existing entries at commit and report partial write failures accurately.
